$description: Package Broker design tokens. Source of truth; tokens.css, tailwind-theme.css and infima.css are generated from this file by scripts/build-tokens.mjs.

surface-subtle.$description: Table header, sidebar, secondary fills. Not a hover colour (use surface-hover).

surface-hover.$description: Pointer hover fill for neutral rows, items and secondary buttons. Always one step away from the container fill it sits on; never used for selection.

surface-active.$description: Pressed fill for neutral controls. Strictly stronger than surface-hover.

border.$description: Decorative dividers only; never the only boundary of a control.

border-control.$description: Boundary of inputs, checkboxes, secondary buttons; 3:1 on bg and the four surfaces (see the pair table).

text-muted.$description: Secondary text, help text, table meta.

text-disabled.$description: Disabled control text; exempt from 1.4.3, never used for information.

accent-solid.$description: Primary button fill, checked control fill.

accent-solid-active.$description: Pressed fill of the primary action. Strictly stronger than accent-solid-hover in both themes.

accent-subtle.$description: Selection only: selected nav item, selected row, pressed filter chip, current page.

accent-subtle-hover.$description: Hover on an already selected item (selected plus hover). Selection itself is accent-subtle.

focus.$description: Focus ring on bg and the four surfaces plus accent-subtle; 3:1 on each (see the pair table). On inverse surfaces use focus-inverse.

focus-inverse.$description: Focus ring on inverse surfaces (toast, tooltip). The global focus token fails 3:1 there.

brand.$description: Logo mark and website illustration only; never text under 24px, never status.

inverse-bg.$description: Tooltip and toast fill. Supports inverse-text, inverse-text-muted and focus-inverse only; no link, border or disabled role.

fg.$description: success text and icon on success-bg or any surface.

border.$description: success alert edge and badge outline.

fg.$description: warning text and icon on warning-bg or any surface.

border.$description: warning alert edge and badge outline.

fg.$description: danger text and icon on danger-bg or any surface.

border.$description: danger alert edge and badge outline.

solid-active.$description: Pressed fill of the destructive action.

fg.$description: info text and icon on info-bg or any surface.

border.$description: info alert edge and badge outline.

fg.$description: neutral text and icon on neutral-bg or any surface.

border.$description: neutral alert edge and badge outline.

series-1.$description: Categorical slot 1 (blue); fixed slot per entity, at least 3:1 against surface and surface-raised, never the only signal.

series-2.$description: Categorical slot 2 (orange); fixed slot per entity, at least 3:1 against surface and surface-raised, never the only signal.

series-3.$description: Categorical slot 3 (green); fixed slot per entity, at least 3:1 against surface and surface-raised, never the only signal.

series-4.$description: Categorical slot 4 (amber); fixed slot per entity, at least 3:1 against surface and surface-raised, never the only signal.

series-5.$description: Categorical slot 5 (pink); fixed slot per entity, at least 3:1 against surface and surface-raised, never the only signal.

series-6.$description: Categorical slot 6 (cyan); fixed slot per entity, at least 3:1 against surface and surface-raised, never the only signal.

series-7.$description: Categorical slot 7 (violet); fixed slot per entity, at least 3:1 against surface and surface-raised, never the only signal.

series-8.$description: Categorical slot 8 (olive); fixed slot per entity, at least 3:1 against surface and surface-raised, never the only signal.

no-data.$description: Missing or zero data. Always labelled; never the only signal.

page-gutter.$description: Page side gutter below the md breakpoint; 24 px from md up (space-6).

icon-stroke.$description: Icon stroke width in rendered pixels at every icon size (non-scaling stroke).

loop-spin.$description: One revolution of the loading spinner. Looping animation, not a transition; stops under reduced motion.

loop-shimmer.$description: One sweep of the skeleton shimmer. Looping animation; stops under reduced motion.

xs.$description: Smallest supported viewport (WCAG 1.4.10 reflow at 320 CSS px). sm and up means small phone and larger.

broker.package.contrastExempt.reason: WCAG 1.4.3 exempts text of inactive components. Never use for information (an explanation next to a disabled item uses text-muted).
Decorative divider (table rows, card edge); never the only boundary of a control. prefers-contrast: more promotes it to border-control.
Translucent overlay behind a modal; measured by the contrast of what is drawn on top of it, not by itself.
Decorative gridline; values are always also in a data table or direct labels.

broker.package.contrastIgnore.reason: Check mark, radio dot and switch thumb are drawn only while the control background is accent-solid; the stylesheet scanner cannot see the state.
Host background of the checked state; the mark colour is on-accent.
Switch thumb and track are graphics, covered by border-control and accent-solid pairs.

broker.package.contrastContainers.reason: Interactive content inside the toast sits on inverse-bg, so its focus ring is checked against it. Removing the focus-inverse rule makes the global focus token apply and the check fails.
